//: Firebase CLI config for Operations Academia. Deploy from THIS directory:
//why-here: The CLI requires every path it references to live inside the config's own directory, so this sits at the repository root beside _firestore.rules. Hosting is NOT configured: the site is served by GitHub Pages, and adding a hosting block here would invite an accidental `firebase deploy` that publishes a second, stale copy of the site at a firebaseapp.com address.

storage.//: The landing strip for uploaded job adverts and CVs — see _storage.rules. Nothing is publicly readable: a file lives here only until the build moves it into the Drive folder for the current job market year.

functions.//: The instant-publish doorbell (_functions/index.js): a posting change dispatches the GitHub build. Deploy: firebase deploy --only functions (needs the GH_DISPATCH_TOKEN secret first — see _SETUP-INSTANT-PUBLISH.md).
